name: io.github.acertijosapps/android-viewer
title: Android Viewer
description: Drive Android emulators: screenshots, taps, swipes, keys, text, rotation and foldable postures.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_VIEWER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Viewer to show actions live (default http://localhost:8093); without it, adb is used directly

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Android SDK location, if adb and emulator are not found automatically
